value.rationale: The paper studies bounded complex responses at T values larger than two, but selected bounded trajectories cannot imply global attractors. This theorem gives an exact all-initial-state confinement frontier, includes a noncontracting endpoint through an explicit nonlinear Lyapunov estimate, and proves that above the boundary an entire explicit exterior basin escapes geometrically even if bounded local dynamics exists. The property is a motivated global invariant/boundary for this newly studied map, not a renaming of local fixed-point stability or an arbitrary numerical slice.
